import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
x = np.arange(0, 10, 0.1)
y1 = 0.05 * x ** 2
y2 = -1 * y1

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots()
ax2 = ax1.twinx() # 把 ax1 的坐标轴镜像翻转
ax1.plot(x, y1, 'g-')
ax2.plot(x, y2, 'b--')
ax1.set_xlabel('X data')
